title: How to Catch an Atom
ogTitle: Jak złapać atom i kazać mu liczyć · How an ion-trap quantum computer works
description: An interactive explainer (PL / EN) of how an ion-trap quantum computer works, with Poland's MIKOK project as the example: the trap, lasers, qubit, entanglement, calibration, and secure access with QKD.
cardText: A scrolling explainer of a quantum computer made of single calcium atoms, with Poland's MIKOK project as the example. Play with the lasers to write, read and reset a qubit, run a Bell circuit, and see how jobs reach the machine securely, including QKD. Polish and English.
imageAlt: How to catch an atom and make it compute: a row of glowing calcium ions held in an ion trap
